rule: Each entry names a package placed beyond the 24 mm locality limit, the ruling and its evidence or cause. Input buffers accepted by Revision 2 item 3 carry their routing conditions; input_buffer_beyond_locality entries (Revision 7 item 1) carry the same conditions and their run estimates; interim_gh_locality_exception entries (Revision 6 item 4) are general analog parts displaced by the interim GH header sites, to be revisited at Gate A. Decouplers move with their IC and stay within the bypass limit. The floorplan report repeats every entry and fails if the package is not on the named board.
